evals.name: synthetic-backfill
evals.prompt: Backfill this completed agent session as a case. The branch and tests exist, but I have not reviewed the transcript or patch yet.
evals.expected_output: The case defaults to observed, unvalidated, human review pending, and separates branch existence from technical and human validation.
assertions: Does not mark the synthetic backfill contributor-validated
Records retrievable branch, commit, test, and issue handles
Marks unreviewed runtime claims as reported or unknown
Does not promote a candidate lesson

evals.name: merged-without-proof
evals.prompt: This PR merged yesterday. Turn it into a case, but nobody recorded a fix-absent test run or verified the released package.
evals.expected_output: Delivery is merged while technical validation and artifact proof remain separate and conservative.
assertions: Records merged delivery without claiming released
Does not infer red-capable coverage from merge
Names missing fix-absent and artifact evidence
Keeps maintainer acceptance separate from technical validation

evals.name: private-incident-boundary
evals.prompt: Capture this internal incident as a public case. The transcript includes customer payloads, private Slack messages, and internal repository paths.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses to copy private evidence into a public case and either keeps it approved-private or records only a sanitized coverage gap.
assertions: Does not publish customer or private conversation content
Requires an approved private destination or sanitization
Preserves provenance without local paths or identities
Does not fabricate public evidence handles

evals.name: reinforce-existing-pattern
evals.prompt: Record this completed public case. The evidence reinforces pattern.drive-the-shipped-surface and should update compiled knowledge without changing any installable skill.
evals.expected_output: The case uses schema 2, selects link-existing with the pattern ID, adds reciprocal evidence links, regenerates projections, and leaves skills unchanged.
assertions: Records exactly one link-existing disposition and pattern target
Adds the case as evidence on the existing pattern
Updates provenance only for supported typed relationships
Does not modify an installable skill

evals.name: candidate-pattern-boundary
evals.prompt: This reviewed case has a transferable mechanism but matches no compiled pattern. Record it and create the smallest candidate pattern without promoting procedure.
evals.expected_output: The case selects create-candidate, the new pattern remains candidate and cites the case, projections regenerate, and no skill procedure changes.
assertions: Records exactly one create-candidate disposition and pattern target
Creates a candidate rather than active pattern
Links the case as source evidence
Does not promote or mutate procedure

evals.name: gap-or-no-change
evals.prompt: The evidence is ambiguous and may not justify a reusable pattern. Record the case conservatively and choose between a known compiled gap or no compiled change.
evals.expected_output: The case selects exactly one durable outcome: gap with an existing gap ID or no-change with none, without inventing a pattern.
assertions: Selects exactly one allowed knowledge disposition
Uses an existing gap ID or the literal none target
Does not fabricate a pattern from ambiguous evidence
Does not mutate an installable skill
